Name: Huckleberry Season
Author: maerumaer2u
Description:
[center][color=#ffe599][b]For Stardew Valley 1.5.6 only!  For a 1.6-compatible version see MarsCBG's Content Patcher [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23859]conversion [/url]﻿of this mod[/b][/color][/center]

Huckleberries are coming to the Valley!

These delicious berries spawn anywhere you can find wild berry bushes.  They're slightly more nutritious than salmonberries and blackberries, but you'll only find them from Summer 12 to 16.

This mod requires Bush Bloom Mod, Json Assets, and all associated dependencies.

Gift tastes are included for vanilla villagers.

This mod only adds huckleberries; it doesn't add any additional recipes or artisan goods.  However, mod makers should feel free to use these huckleberries in recipes, artisan goods, gift tastes for an NPC [i]that you created[/i], anything!  All I ask is that huckleberries be kept as wild forage and not made into a growable crop.  Other than that, I'm excited to see what you cook up! Check 'em out below:

Updates:
March 29, 2023: I've added an optional file for compatibility with the huckleberry in Raffadax Complete Production.  Includes JA, BBM, and BAGI components that rename the huckleberry in my mod to "Purple Huckleberry."  [i]Only use this version if you use Raffadax Complete Production[/i].
March 24, 2023: I've added a vanilla-style BAGI pack as an optional file. 
March 13, 2023:Wickedy has created a huckleberry add-on to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15615]Berry Snacks[/url]
